name: losi-context-bank
description: Context infrastructure for LLMs — persistent memory, CRM, workspace, and governance across any model.
author: Marshmallow Studio (https://losi.ai)

scripts.build:serial: for p in core openai anthropic gemini mistral cohere groq ollama mcp nexus spaces skills governance react; do npm run build -w @losi-ai/$p || exit 1; done
scripts.clean: npm run clean --workspaces --if-present && rm -rf packages/*/dist packages/*/*.tsbuildinfo
scripts.demos: npm run build:serial && npm run demo:all -w @losi-ai/examples
